queryLines:
with cloud_storage_pricing as 
(
   select storage_pricing as target_cloud_storage_pricing,
   upper(target_cloud) as target_cloud,
   CASE 
      WHEN upper(target_cloud) = 'AWS' THEN 3.6 -- S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval
      WHEN upper(target_cloud) = 'AZURE' THEN 2.0 -- Azure Archive
      ELSE target_cloud_storage_pricing -- No archival in GCP
   END AS target_cloud_storage_archival_pricing
   from <CATALOG_NAME>.<SCHEMA_NAME>.input_params
)
SELECT t.* except (total_physical_tb_to_migrate, source),
target_cloud_storage_pricing,
target_cloud_storage_archival_pricing,
GREATEST((active_logical_tb - 0.01) * 20.0, 0.0)
+ 
GREATEST((long_term_logical_tb - 0.01) * 10.0, 0.0)
+ 
GREATEST((active_physical_tb + fail_safe_physical_tb - 0.01) * 40.0, 0.0)
+ 
GREATEST((long_term_physical_tb - 0.01) * 20.0, 0.0)
 as storage_cost_bq,
 (
    active_logical_tb +
    active_no_tt_physical_tb
 ) as total_tb_to_migrate_as_active_primary,
 (long_term_logical_tb + long_term_physical_tb) as total_tb_to_migrate_as_archived_primary,
 (total_tb_to_migrate_as_active_primary * target_cloud_storage_pricing) as migrated_active_primary_data_cost,
 total_tb_to_migrate_as_archived_primary * target_cloud_storage_archival_pricing as migrated_archived_primary_data_cost,
 (migrated_active_primary_data_cost + migrated_archived_primary_data_cost) as migrated_primary_data_cost,
 (fail_safe_physical_tb + time_travel_physical_tb) as total_tb_to_migrate_optional,
 (total_tb_to_migrate_optional * target_cloud_storage_pricing) as migrated_optional_data_cost
FROM <CATALOG_NAME>.<SCHEMA_NAME>.table_storage t,
cloud_storage_pricing
WHERE metadata_level = :metadata_level

datasets.name: 1f1957c8
queryLines:
-- Streaming inserts (legacy API): $0.010 per 200 MB, which equals $50 per TB of successfully inserted data.
--	Write API (recommended method):
---- Free for up to 2 TB per project per month per region
---- Beyond that: $25 per TB of data successfully ingested.

with error_adjusted_streaming_inserts as 
(
  select date_format(start_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM') as month_window,
  total_input_bytes / (1024.0 * 1024.0 * 1024.0 * 1024.0) as total_input_tb,
  (1 - coalesce(try_divide(total_error, total_requests), 0.0)) as salvage_rate,
  total_input_tb * salvage_rate as total_input_tb_error_adjusted
  from <CATALOG_NAME>.<SCHEMA_NAME>.streaming_summary
),
error_adjusted_write_api as 
(
  select date_format(start_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM') as month_window, 
  split(metadata_level, "\\.")[1] as region,
  total_input_bytes / (1024.0 * 1024.0 * 1024.0 * 1024.0) as total_input_tb,
  (1 - coalesce(try_divide(total_error, total_requests), 0.0)) as salvage_rate,
  total_input_tb * salvage_rate as total_input_tb_error_adjusted
  from <CATALOG_NAME>.<SCHEMA_NAME>.write_api_summary
),
 error_adjusted_write_api_region_wise as
(
  select month_window, 
  region,
  sum(total_input_tb) as total_input_tb,
  sum(total_input_tb_error_adjusted) as total_input_tb_error_adjusted
  from error_adjusted_write_api
  group by month_window, region
),
error_adjusted_write_api_region_wise_billable as
(
  select month_window,
  region,
  total_input_tb,
  case 
    when total_input_tb < 2.0 then 0.0 
    else (total_input_tb - 2.0) 
    end as total_input_tb_billable,
  total_input_tb_billable * 25.0 as total_input_tb_cost,
  total_input_tb_error_adjusted,
  case 
    when total_input_tb_error_adjusted < 2.0 then 0.0 
    else (total_input_tb_error_adjusted - 2.0) 
    end as total_input_tb_error_adjusted_billable,
  total_input_tb_error_adjusted_billable * 25.0 as total_input_tb_error_adjusted_cost
  from error_adjusted_write_api_region_wise
)
select month_window,
'Streaming Insert' as streaming_type,
round(sum(total_input_tb), 2) as total_input_tb,
round(sum(total_input_tb_error_adjusted), 2) as total_input_tb_error_adjusted,
round(sum(total_input_tb * 50.0), 2) as total_input_tb_cost,
round(sum(total_input_tb_error_adjusted * 50.0), 2) as total_input_tb_error_adjusted_cost,
round(sum(total_input_tb_error_adjusted * 50.0), 2) * 0.25 as db_streaming_cost
from error_adjusted_streaming_inserts
group by month_window
UNION
select month_window,
'Write API' as streaming_type,
sum(total_input_tb) as total_input_tb,
round(sum(total_input_tb_error_adjusted), 2) as total_input_tb_error_adjusted,
round(sum(total_input_tb_cost), 2) as total_input_tb_cost,
round(sum(total_input_tb_error_adjusted_cost), 2) as total_input_tb_error_adjusted_cost,
round(sum(total_input_tb_error_adjusted_cost), 2) * 0.25 as db_streaming_cost
from error_adjusted_write_api_region_wise_billable
group by month_window;

datasets.name: e15c98b2
queryLines:
with slots_pricing_analysis as
(
    SELECT *,
    0.0 as vm_price_perf_based
    FROM <CATALOG_NAME>.<SCHEMA_NAME>.bq_slots_pricing_analysis
),
monthly_costs as
(
    SELECT 
    month_window,
    SUM(bq_estimated_price) as bq_cost,
    SUM(IDENTIFIER(:slot_estimation_approach)) as databricks_compute_cost,
    SUM(IDENTIFIER(replace(:slot_estimation_approach, 'db_', 'vm_'))) as cloud_vm_cost,
    SUM(IDENTIFIER(:slot_estimation_approach)) + SUM(IDENTIFIER(replace(:slot_estimation_approach, 'db_', 'vm_'))) as db_total_cost
    from slots_pricing_analysis
    GROUP BY month_window
)
select median(bq_cost)*12.0 as bq_cost_median,
median(databricks_compute_cost)*12.0 as databricks_compute_cost_median,
median(cloud_vm_cost)*12.0 as cloud_vm_cost_median,
(databricks_compute_cost_median + cloud_vm_cost_median) as db_total_cost_median,
(bq_cost_median - db_total_cost_median) as db_savings,
coalesce(try_divide(bq_cost_median - db_total_cost_median, bq_cost_median), 0.00) as db_savings_perc
from monthly_costs
